mapper.select: SELECT id, event_code, job_code, status, publishing_token, publishing_lease_until, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_outbox_event WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_outbox_event SET status = 2, publishing_token = #{publishingToken}, publishing_lease_until = #{publishingLeaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_code = #{eventCode} AND status = 0
UPDATE knowledge_index_outbox_event SET status = 0, failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND status = 1
